beats.text: What if your only database dies?
beats.say: What happens if your only database server dies? Or if a million people try to read from it at once?

beats.text: Replication keeps copies on several servers.
beats.say: Replication keeps copies of your data on several servers.

beats.text: Writes go to the leader, then to followers.
beats.say: All writes go to the leader. It then sends every change to its followers.
Reads can be spread across the followers, so you can handle far more traffic.

beats.text: Replication lag: a read can be stale.
beats.say: But replication takes time. A follower can lag behind, so a read may return stale data.

beats.text: Leader fails? A follower is promoted.
beats.say: And if the leader fails, a follower is promoted to take over, so your app keeps running.

beats.text: Next up: leader election. Follow for more!
beats.say: Next up, leader election. Follow for more system design.
